prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1133; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by your insured's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office, and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of your company has been in contact with our client, please let us know.

We request that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident, including photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, vehicle data, repair records, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.
